Maria (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — vendor & marketplace joint go-live planned next Wed. Need a short sync on embargo window, SI handoffs, and fallback strategy for H200/B200. Who can own the runbook?
Jason (Product): timeline + expected SKU list? we should lock that before comms.
Maria (Partnerships): Timeline: canary Tue 09:00 PT, full push Wed 11:00 PT. SKU list is in the draft doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partnerships/pages/marketplace-handoff — add comments.
Leo (Eng-Infra): flag — our lab repro showed B200 with microcode v1.2.3 -> occasional kernel OOM under load. Vendor said 1.2.4 is coming but cert takes time. Recommend adding a routing fallback to H100-quantized for the first 24h.
Anand (NVIDIA): We're pushing mc 1.2.4 signing jobs now; signed artifacts ETA EOD PDT. For marketplace temp SKU use `nv-b200-temp-2026-03` until signed tag is propagated.
Sara (Comms): embargo window? we need firm times to coordinate press + marketplace listing.
Maria (Partnerships): propose embargo Tue 08:30–12:30 PT for canary validation, soft announce Wed 12:00 PT after verification. Need signoff by EOD Mon from eng + vendor.
Jason (Product): SI integrators will require updated cookbooks and driver matrix. Can we share a minimal checklist for SI leads to action?
Leo (Eng-Infra): Minimal SI checklist: driver package (NVIDIA driver 535.45 or later); docker base `redwood/rlib:gpu-2026-03`; kernel config: `CONFIG_CGROUPS=y` enabled; add these checks to preflight. Example quick-check command:
```
# quick smoke
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,clocks.current.memory --format=csv
python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"
```
Maria (Partnerships): adding vendor SI contacts inline: @Anand (NVIDIA) is primary; cc: vendor-ops@nv.com.
Anand (NVIDIA): FYI SI lead is Priya (priya_nv) — she'll join the runbook call tomorrow.
Leo (Eng-Infra): Canary plan: route 1% traffic NA -> EU canary for 12h; if error rate <0.5% and p95 latency delta <20ms, promote. Will create route config. Example policy snippet:
```
route:
  weight: 1
  fallback: h100-quantized
  circuit_breaker:
    error_threshold_percent: 5
    request_volume: 50
    sleep_window_ms: 300000
```
deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: id=cny-20260309-78, window=2026-03-09T16:00:00Z->2026-03-09T20:00:00Z, config=https://deploys.redwood.internal/cny-78/logs
Sara (Comms): need final checklist to ack for embargo. I'll prepare a short press note template once checklist is green.
Maria (Partnerships): final signoff checklist (one-line items): firmware signed; marketplace SKU mapped; SI cookbook published; canary pass 12h; metrics healthcheck alert <=0.5% errors; fallback policy in place; vendor ack on embargo.
Jason (Product): I'll own marketplace SKU mapping.
Leo (Eng-Infra): Eng will own fallback routing + canary config. We'll add an automated rollback trigger at 1% failed requests in 10m.
Anand (NVIDIA): I'll confirm signed firmware and update Priya to push SI notes by EOD.
Maria (Partnerships): Great. Next steps: 1) Eng creates route + rollback by EOD; 2) Vendor pushes signed artifact EOD; 3) Product maps SKUs; 4) Comms drafts press template. Call tomorrow 09:30 PT if any blockers.
Sara (Comms): :thumbsup:
Leo (Eng-Infra): noted. I'll post the route config PR shortly.
Maria (Partnerships): thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for runbook comments.
